title: Production Readiness Audit - MotaDSLUM NATS Microservice

stories.title: Missing workerpool initialization and graceful shutdown
acceptanceCriteria: workerpool.MustInit() is called in main() before any handler is created
workerpool.ShutdownWithTimeout(5s) is called explicitly before srv.Stop() during shutdown
go build succeeds with no compilation errors

stories.title: Password field exposed in JSON responses
acceptanceCriteria: User struct Password field has json:"-" tag instead of json:"password"
go build succeeds with no compilation errors

stories.title: microRequestAdapter.Context() loses SDK metadata (tenant ID, correlation ID, trace context)
acceptanceCriteria: microRequestAdapter.Context() calls core.InjectContext with request headers (not bare context.Background())
SDK metadata (tenant ID, correlation ID, trace context) is available to handlers via context
go build succeeds with no compilation errors

stories.title: Log level hardcoded to debug - not production configurable
acceptanceCriteria: Log level reads from LOG_LEVEL env var with fallback to 'info'
Environment reads from APP_ENV env var with fallback to 'production'
go build succeeds with no compilation errors

stories.title: UserRoles relation hook stubs missing OTEL child spans
acceptanceCriteria: preAssignHook, postAssignHook, preListHook, postListHook, preRemoveHook, postRemoveHook all create child spans via tracer.Start()
go build succeeds with no compilation errors

stories.title: Interactive demo should show live app logs alongside test output
acceptanceCriteria: Demo script tails docker compose logs in background during test execution
Logs are visually separated from test output (color/prefix)
Log tailing is cleaned up on script exit
docker-compose.yml has LOG_LEVEL=debug and APP_ENV=development for app service
